Command: Do not desire silver or gold on idols
Summary: Deuteronomy 7:25 forbids desiring the silver and gold on graven images: 'thou shalt not desire the silver or gold that is on them, nor take it unto thee, lest thou be snared therein: for it is an abomination to the LORD thy God.' The wealth on an idol is still the idol's wealth.
Commandment: Do not desire, or take for yourself, the silver or gold on idols.
Application: Profit does not purify idolatry: taking an idol's ornaments home imports the snare with the silver. What God calls abomination is not made clean by being valuable.
Purpose: Scripture's stated reason: lest thou be snared therein, for it is an abomination to the LORD thy God (Deuteronomy 7:25).
